profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
I am a passionate, experienced software developer who enjoys challenging problems and leading a team to success.  

I have worked with an extensive array of technologies and languages over the years from managed .NET to native mobile to embedded C and assembly.  I enjoy and excel at solving difficult problems, from optimizing mobile applications for responsiveness to designing scalable, redundant, secure backend systems, to isolating bugs in compilers.

I always pay attention to ease of use in the software I write whether it will be used by other developers, internal staff, or the general public.  I enjoy close interaction with UI/UX designers to strike a balance between functionality, intuitiveness, elegance and technical limitations.
